# Health.md roll-up summary v8 fixtures

The four weekly fixtures are byte-for-byte copies of canonical generated Health.md reference artifacts. They contain no user health data. The generated CSV intentionally has no schema/version columns and exercises explicit unversioned legacy CSV behavior.
